figures -> manuscript writing -> peer review -> submission -> NSFC grants. Covers
life-science & biomedical domains: neuroscience, oncology, immunology, cardiovascular,
metabolism, development, microbiology, pharmacology, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, PRISMA

inversion, far-domain analogy, ontological reframe, anomaly-first...) yielding original
candidates + a kill order, decoupled from evaluation. Triggers: 文献/综述/开题/生信/组学/
实验设计/统计作图/论文写作/标书/Meta + biomedical & life-science keywords. Standards:
verifiable citations (PMID/DOI), versioned+seeded reproducible scripts, effect size +
multiple-comparison correction. Python engine (matplotlib/scipy/statsmodels) with
dependency self-check; R for bioinformatics. Deliverables default to Word (.docx).
Excludes clinical diagnosis/treatment advice.
